div.div: سَأّ=رٌ One who leaves a remainder, or residue, (S, M, K,) of beverage in the bottom of the vessel from which he has drunk: (S, M:) [and (tropical:) of food in a dish; &c.:] deviating from rule, (S, M,) like جَبَّارٌ from أَجْبَرَ: (S:) [see دَرَّاكٌ, which is said to be the only other instance of the kind:] by rule it should be ↓ مُسْئِرٌ ; (S, K;) which is [said to be] also allowable: (K:) but MF denies this; (TA;) or it may be [regular] from سَأَرَ or [irregular] from أَسْأَرَ. (T, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
